behavior: A pay link carries a secret token and the chain shows only its hash, so an invoice id read from chain opens nothing
acceptance: Create gives each invoice a payToken of 32 random bytes; the main invoice id is keccak256 of it; option ids still derive from the main id; terms and receive addresses keep their form.

The public routes (invoice read, Check status, payer email, invoice and receipt PDFs) take the token; an invoice id or option id there is 404. On Anvil, the id from a settled invoice's ReceiverDeployed log opens none of them.
The pay page /pay/<token> shows an address only when keccak256(token) is the terms' invoiceId; the owner's page, every email, both PDFs, the job quote page and the canary link by token.
An invoice made before has no token: its public routes are 404 and its owner page shows no pay link (testnet data only).
A decision replaces D-50's link rule; R-114, api.md, openapi.yaml, money-safety.md and the web docs describe the token.
